messages:
Maya R.: FYI customer ACME on prod is getting 403 that the UI shows as 'invalid_api_key' for POST /v1/generate. They upgraded to Enterprise and we ran a SAML seat migration yesterday. Customer says their key didn't change. I can repro in our staging with their tenant id. Posting curl and logs below.

Maya R.: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_ACME_PLACEHOLDER' \\n  -H 'X-Tenant-ID: tenant-acme-123' \\n  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Samir K.: thanks. can you paste the request_id from the logs and the timestamp of the failing request? also which cluster (prod-eu/prod-us)?

Maya R.: request_id=01H8Y2XQ9JZ, ts=2026-11-06T14:02:12Z, cluster=prod-us. logs show entitlement service returning a deny but API layer surfaces as auth error. snippet: ```
[entitlement-service] tenant=tenant-acme-123 check=feature:advanced-llm result=DENIED code=ENTITLEMENT_DENIED reason="no_license_claim"
[api-gateway] request_id=01H8Y2XQ9JZ responding 403 message="invalid_api_key"
```

Support Bot: plan-sync-job-prod reported failure at 2026-11-06T03:12:04Z (retry 3). Created job run id=psj-9876.

Lisa P.: billing shows tenant-acme-123 has Enterprise SKU recorded in billing DB, but the entitlement cache for that tenant shows tier=free. looks like claim attributes from the SAML migration didn't get set in the entitlement-service.

Samir K.: hypothesis: during SAML seat migration the assertion did not include `license_tier` claim for some tenants. entitlement-service falls back to free and blocks advanced features. API gateway maps any entitlement failure to the generic "invalid_api_key" message (legacy behaviour).

Samir K.: repro steps for eng: 1) ingest SAML assertion without `license_tier` 2) run entitlement refresh 3) call /v1/generate with tenant header -> observe entitlement deny and gateway 403 mapped to auth.

Maya R.: customer-facing workaround we can offer now? telling them to re-run migration on their IdP isn't great. can we provide a short-term fix server-side?

Ben T.: I can push a hotfix to stop masking entitlement errors as auth errors. change mapping so API returns 403 with error_code=entitlement_blocked and human message "plan does not include feature". that'll be deployed to prod-us in ~30m if no blockers. also will trigger a one-off plan-sync for psj-9876.

Lisa P.: I'll run a billing -> entitlement reconciliation for affected tenants and surface list to Maya. looks like ~6 tenants hit the same flow in the last 24h.

Maya R.: OK i'll reply to the customer: explain we found entitlement mismatch after migration, temporary workaround is to wait for reconciliation or ask their IdP admin to re-send assertions with the `license_tier` attribute. i'll say we expect clearer error messaging within 1h and a follow-up when plan-sync completes.

Samir K.: also adding a short-term telemetry change: emit metric entitlement_missing_claim flagged_by=saml_migration for faster triage.

Ben T.: hotfix deployed to prod-us at 14:25 UTC. mapping changed so customers see `error: entitlement_blocked` with message about plan/feature. ran plan-sync job psj-9876 again, now succeeded.

Maya R.: confirmed with customer — they received the new error message and then we reconciled their entitlement; their requests now succeed. customer asked for root cause notes and a follow-up on preventing this for future migrations. i'll open a support ticket and link to the postmortem.

Samir K.: filing action items: (1) idp/saml docs update for migration checklist (2) fix entitlement fallback logic to require explicit deny/allow (3) add e2e check after migrations to validate claims.

Maya R.: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and mark this escalated -> resolved once postmortem is posted.
